At Meridian Facilities Group, we saw significant improvements after integrating Slatebridge into our operations. Over six months, overtime hours dropped by 18%, and SLA compliance jumped from 87% to a remarkable 96%. Our dispatchers no longer rely on whiteboards, streamlining the process for everyone involved.

"I used to spend my mornings untangling the schedule," says our operations director. "Now I focus on customers."

For companies looking to enhance efficiency without complex software, Slatebridge offers a practical solution.
